caption: The drawing depicts a two-piece outfit consisting of a jacket and matching trousers, rendered in a beige or light cream color. The jacket has long sleeves and a short, open front with decorative black trim along the collar, front edges, cuffs, and hem. The black trim is designed in a repeated looped or coiled pattern. The trousers are high-waisted with vertical pinstripes and feature the same black looped trim running down the outer side of each leg and around the bottom cuffs. There are also black buttons at the bottom of each pant leg and just below the waistband. The drawing is centered on a plain, light background, and the clothing appears empty, without a visible mannequin or person.
title: Boy's Suit
